description: A responsive KPI card grid for Power BI — one card per metric, each with its own value, target and variance pill, laid out in a grid that fits the space you give it. One visual replaces a page of individually placed cards. Codex KPI Wall is for the scorecard at the top of a report: the six or eight numbers everyone checks first, kept consistent in size, spacing and styling without hand-aligning a single card. IDEAL FOR Executive scorecards and the summary strip at the top of a report Replacing a row of individually placed card visuals that drift out of alignment Dashboards where the metric list changes and the layout must keep up Mixed direction metrics, where some should go up and others down KEY FEATURES Auto-fit columns, or fix the grid at 1 to 6 columns Minimum card width and card gap are both adjustable, so the wall reflows to the visual size Every card carries its label, value, target and a variance pill against that target Three accent styles — flat bar, glass tube and corner bracket — with one or two corners Status dot, variance pill, subtitle and progress strip can each be switched off Sort order field controls the order cards appear in Full font control on values and labels, including an uppercase toggle for labels Background colour with transparency, border with width, colour and radius Card signature accent with style, colour, corner radius and…
